messages:
Priya: Heads up — US-west GPU invoice for March arrived and it's ~22% higher than forecast. There's an ~$18k unallocated bucket under project=ephemeral-runner-01 :eyes:
Anya: Is that the new CI autoscale pool we flipped last week?
Ben: Correct. Autoscaler bug prevented proper scale-down of spot instances; those nodes kept accruing charges. I filed an infra ticket and am digging into logs.
Luis: Reproduced. A config change accidentally set `min_nodes: 2` for the spot pool in us-west. The controller persisted nodes even when demand dropped. Quick check: `kubectl get hpa -n infra-autoscale` showed the mismatch.
Priya: Can we retro-tag the runs so finance can attribute costs to teams? Our cost reports currently surface this as `unlabeled` which breaks chargebacks.
Ben: I'll run a backfill that maps VM instance ids to repo/PR metadata and add labels in the billing export. Query I'm using in BigQuery:
```
SELECT
  resource.labels.instance_id,
  project.id AS project,
  SUM(cost) AS cost
FROM `billing.gcp_export.ga_billing_*`
WHERE invoice_month = '2026-03'
  AND labels.autoscale_pool = 'ephemeral-runner-01'
GROUP BY resource.labels.instance_id, project.id;
```
Results -> shared sheet once ready.
Anya: If we can get that before EOD we can adjust team budgets before the monthly close. Finance, what's the retro reclassification process?
finance-bot: Reminder: cost reclassification window = 30 days. Submit a ticket in #finance with CSV (instance_id, owner_team, amount, invoice_id). Automated job will apply adjustments to next internal allocation run.
Priya: Filing ticket now. I'll attach Ben's sheet once it's published. Also wondering if a vendor credit request is viable for these orphan charges?
CFO-Bot: Note: Vendor prepay/commit decisions affect liquidity. Recommend reclassification unless projected recurring exposure > $25k and pattern is repeatable; escalate to finance leadership in that case.
Luis: Mitigation: reverted the `min_nodes` override and added a safety guard in autoscale controller (patch rev 3a7f). Will monitor for next 2 cycles.
Ben: Backfill running — ETA ~3 hours. Will post CSV + sheet link when complete. :thumbsup:
Anya: After reclassification, please run an internal alert report to identify teams near alert thresholds so we can top-up budgets if needed.
Priya: Action summary: Ben -> produce CSV & sheet, Priya -> create finance ticket & attach CSV, Luis -> confirm fix and monitor, Anya -> update alert/budget runs.
Ben: Sheet posted: https://redwood-internal/sheets/3k9g (read-only).
finance-bot: Ticket FIN-2026-483 created. Attach CSV + invoice id to proceed with reclassification.
Priya: I'll close the loop once the ticket is processed. Post here if any new catches. :white_check_mark:
